rationale: No refinery-throughput series is visible in the catalogue, so we test the outcome directly: SO2 is the most refinery-specific CAMS pollutant for Houston, and its anomaly vs the same-week 2025 baseline (removing seasonality) should be higher in the war period than pre-war if refineries ran harder; confounders include weather, model-reanalysis artefacts, and other 2026 emission changes.
